name: governed-action-loop
summary: The action loop an agent runs inside: three fixed hooks, W1 confirmed once, W2 under dual control, taint ceiling, kill switches, budgets, a chained record
test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 example.py

spec.document: CrossRiver AI Platform on AgentCore, design specification 0.21 (2026-09-16)
spec.replacement_test: The consumer restarts unchanged when the in-process gateway is AgentCore Gateway with the same bundle in AgentCore Policy, the local HMAC key is KMS signing, and the SQLite stores are the control layer's; the conformance test on the three hooks passes on both.
